exposure: gestational age of index stillbirth (<28 weeks or >=28 weeks)
mode of index stillbirth (fetal death in utero or termination of pregnancy)
cohort: Women who completed a pregnancy beyond 20 weeks at the Royal Women's Hospital between January 1, 2020, and December 31, 2022, following a previous pregnancy that ended in stillbirth.
finding: Pregnancies following a previous stillbirth are associated with increased care provision and higher rates of intervention, but generally reassuring maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: High rates of labour induction (39.5%) and caesarean delivery (41.3%) were observed in subsequent pregnancies.
